relations.reading: An operator-led walkthrough could make the judgment behind the exhibit teachable without pretending the interface contains all tacit knowledge.

relations.title: Contrafactual de carga humana
relations.reading: Knowledge-transfer evidence can include safe novel-exception exercises rather than relying only on document completion.

relations.title: Comunidades de práctica
relations.reading: The China account describes communities proposed and initiated for regional transfer; tacit-knowledge transmission provides a complementary explanation of what such transfer requires.

relations.title: Remanente no recuperable
relations.reading: The calibration case distinguishes knowledge that can be taught through practice from information that an application inventory cannot reconstruct by itself.

relations.title: Coste de claridad
relations.reading: The minimum information for an architecture decision may include an operator's situated judgment, making its acquisition a real project cost.

relations.title: Continuidad distribuida
relations.reading: Cross-border knowledge transfer includes the ability to handle local exceptions, not merely the movement of manuals or personnel.

relations.title: Remanente no recuperable
relations.reading: Where a record cannot reconstruct situated judgment, capability preservation may require a live transmission relationship rather than another layer of documentation.

relations.title: Evidencia de contribución
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge concentration can inform a contribution estimate when tied to observable exception handling and replacement conditions rather than reputation.

relations.title: Coeficiente de recuperación de capacidad (ρ)
relations.reading: A practice-based transmission programme could provide the capability-recovery arm of an HID intervention, separately from the integration fix that releases time.

relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
relations.reading: The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.

relations.title: Condiciones de activación de capacidad
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge transmission offers a practical route for making activation capacity less dependent on a few irreplaceable carriers at the critical moment.

relations.title: Custodia institucional
relations.reading: Preserving an artifact is only one layer; the tacit-knowledge model explains how observation, rehearsal and apprenticeship can preserve the judgment needed to use it.

relations.title: Ciclo exploración–explotación
relations.reading: The watchmaking case suggests a practical distinction between commemorating inherited know-how and keeping it usable within a federated operating architecture.

relations.title: Comunidades de práctica
relations.reading: The community-of-practice idea becomes operational when participants can observe judgment, rehearse it and retain an apprenticeship path for novel exceptions.

relations.title: Comunidades de práctica
relations.reading: The ceramics interview provides a bounded illustration of practice exchange; it does not by itself establish a sustained community or lasting skill transfer.

relations.title: Conocimiento de dominio
relations.reading: The ceramics encounter can illustrate situated transmission, while the tacit-knowledge model supplies questions for observing practice and later independent judgment.

relations.title: Federación de capacidades
relations.reading: Craft exchange and federated watchmaking suggest a shared design question: what must travel between specialists so that coordination preserves rather than flattens their skills?

relations.title: Capacidad humana utilizable
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge transmission could inform a recovery study that distinguishes freed hours from renewed capability to handle novel exceptions.
